hypothesis: A Crown team ID may carry prior market-relative AH payout information across competition IDs when the team changes competitive environment. This differs from earlier league+team-key residual models and generic external-stat cross-league migration.
novelty_audit: The only potentially distinct mechanism is transferring a lagged Crown AH settlement residual across competition IDs for a verified same club. Direct Crown team IDs yielded zero cross-league history; the one-to-one external identity bridge also yielded zero such historical observations in the 2024-26 target pool, so this mechanism was not estimable.
Same-competition team payout features are a control and overlap with earlier team residual / team-contract payout work (R26/R30 and A-L H); they are not presented as a newly discovered source.
Earlier cross-league sports-stat transfer studies moved training rows/metrics across competitions, not lagged same-club Crown AH payout residuals.
R1-R65, A-L and M1-M8 market-only, team residual, familiarity, schedule, player load, motivation, price-state and boundary studies reviewed; no exact positive mechanism was rebranded.

coverage.target_market_field: historical Crown end T1 AH line + paired prices; target event-time, not confirmed HTTP received

time_forward.calendar: Beijing time (UTC+08:00) defines report year, date, ISO week and forward split
time_forward.training: all Crown score/path fixtures strictly earlier China-time calendar years than each target year
time_forward.feature_lag: only prior team matches on China dates earlier than target local date minus 3 days; same-day order excluded conservatively
time_forward.models: Ridge alpha=100, scaler fit on prior years only; model variants and columns fixed before test-year scoring
time_forward.action: one side selected per unique candidate FID by larger predicted Crown unit payout; no abstention threshold and no future T1 group identity/outcome used

market_features: signed current AH line for selected side
models.market_plus_same_competition: market features plus lagged same-team Crown payout summaries within current competition
models.market_plus_verified_club_cross_competit: market features plus lagged same-club Crown payout summaries outside current competition via the anchored identity bridge

identity_bridge.method: one-to-one Crown league/team to Transfermarkt club identity from unique exact-score + normalized team-name anchors; mapping only used after its first anchor date; external outcome values are not predictive features

important_limitations: Historical event-time quotes and payout histories are not contemporaneous received information.
No claim of live fill or formal Telegram orders.
History coverage is restricted to saved Crown path and score inventories.
A fixed ridge action is an experimental estimator, not a trading Gate.
Study design was authored after review of historical reports and is not a preregistered blind discovery.

receipt_raw_sha_and_quote_crosschecks.selection: earliest valid pre-kickoff Crown AH receipt per candidate FID

receipt_validation.limitation: The 2026 model is trained on historical event-time T1 market features and retrospective Crown team-history summaries. This reprice applies receipt-time AH price to the frozen model on the same FIDs; historical team features are not proven contemporaneously available, and target receipt horizons vary. It is not a blinded prospective replay or formal order evidence.
